statusNote: Initial applications for the December 2026 cohort closed on August 31, 2026; approved applicants are in the contribution period.
summary: Outreachy provides paid, remote internships in open source and open science for people who face under-representation, systemic bias or discrimination in the technology industry of their country.

stipend.detail: Every intern is paid $7,000 USD in total for three months of work, the same amount in every country.

facts.label: Length
facts.value: 13 weeks; at least 12 weeks of work

facts.label: Cohorts
facts.value: May to August, and December to March

eligibility: 18 years or older by the internship start date.
Face under-representation, systemic bias or discrimination in the technology industry of your country.
Never been an Outreachy, Outreach Program for Women or Google Summer of Code intern (including unfinished GSoC internships).
No full-time job, full-time contract or other internship during the internship; part-time jobs need organizer approval.
University students need 42 consecutive days free of classes and exams during the internship.
Northern Hemisphere students can only apply for May–August; Southern Hemisphere students only for December–March. Students in India count as Northern Hemisphere.
Your visa must allow 30 hours of work per week.

timeline.label: Initial application results; contribution period opens

howToApply: Submit the initial application with its essays (generative AI is not allowed for the essays).
If approved, contribute to a project during the contribution period and record at least one contribution.
Submit a final application for that project, including a project timeline.
Mentors pick interns; results are announced on the published date.
